create_runconfig: create a RunConfig dataclass instance with logger, task, solver, and interpreter sub-configs
save_runconfig_to_json: save a RunConfig instance to dojo_config.json in the logger output directory
load_runconfig_from_json: load a RunConfig from a dojo_config.json file using the load_from_json class method
build_runconfig_from_dict: build a RunConfig instance from a dictionary using the from_dict class method
validate_runconfig: validate a RunConfig by calling its validate method to recursively check all nested configs
